text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Phew, this year really flew by, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really was busy, wasn't it? The 
hot spring resort is lively as well.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
But... that's precisely why...! What comes 
aaafter "super busy"...?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Time for a good rest right about now! Go 
on, take your time soaking in the bath.
